notes.title: Bugfix & minor update notes for Spring 2023
notes.notes:
Here's an initial list of some of the minor fixes and updates that have been added to the game over the past few months.. 
[h2]New stuff[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Loads of World Editor improvements[/b] : New Screens: GamePlay -> Player Start controls and Global Weapons Settings, Vehicle Setup, Weapons Setup. New layout to make it easier and clearer when you're assigning and uploading models & textures to a world. Lots of work on the asset browser and asset upload screens, including the asset scale and orientation control which means you can adjust per-instance model sizes without having to change the model file - very useful!.  Eraser options for removing walls, bg models etc (which now are reflected immediately on client), landscape editing - you can now paint terrain and have it uploaded to the server -,  better drag and drop controls for buildings, etc, etc. The World Editor is getting really quite useful now.
[*][b]New Weapon Systems[/b] : Lots of rearranging weapon settings - tieing in new per-vehicle weapon slots and making global settings like 'energy-damage-link' mode configurable, etc, etc
[*][b]Linux World Servers & cloud hosting[/b] - World servers now running on Linux again, along with new options to allow automated cloud hosting at the click of a button.
[*][b]Lots of Space Stuff[/b] - New galaxy map, tactical map, Orbit cam, Mining systems, Drives, Trade, tracking of star systems visited - all that kinda stuff. Also a whole new backend. Not finished, not particularly playable, but it exists again.
[*][b]Collision & Replication[/b] - The player replication and collision systems got a lot of attention which should make remote player positioning more accurate and reliable.
[*][b]Script improvements & trace functions[/b] - New scripted hiscores system, *scripttrace commands let you dig into what the serverside script is doing, and a whole pile of general script-language additions, some of which are listed below.
[*][b]Controller/SteamDeck Support[/b] - WIP but various parts of the game should now be playable with a controller. (needs a bit of effort on the controller configs)
[*][b]Various world limits increased[/b] - 60 vehicles instead of 24, 16 robocrow types instead of 8, 24 tiled surfaces instead of 12, 64 texmaps instead of 32, etc. etc.
[*][b]Model Converter updates[/b] - Better FBX support, thumbnail export, animation fixes, turret controls, ability to drag & drop atm and image files into the MC.
[/list]
[h2]BugFixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed pickup buildings
[*]Fix for spaceship textures not always appearing if ships were loaded before the DLC archive was mounted
[*]Fix for occasional crash if rapidly downloading and removing lots of assets
[*]Fix for not being able to lay new surfaces and texmaps in the world ed
[*]Debug tracking of render targets so we can easily track down a rogue one, Fixed some device reset issues that would cause errors when resizing (etc)
[*]Some fixes for reliability of the network connection.
[*]Fix for remote model selector screen just being a feckwit sometimes
[*]Vehicle setup screen shows that vehicle 1 graphic can not be added (and shows the correct texture in the preview window)
[*]Fix for asteroid graphics not loading if they appear in view before the DLC pack has been mounted
[*]Fix for weapon sys not being initialised on the client when theres no weapons.txt on the server
[*]Fix for shadows sometimes not displaying when in spec or RC
[*]Fix for profiler not always showing everything that was going on. (And related FPS improvements once we found out what was going on)
[*]Fixed an annoying little graphical flicker that sometimes happened when particles were about to expire
[*]Some fixes to the replication of turreted vehicles and weapons
[*]Fix for certain PC setups not being able to access secure URLs
[*]Fix for the static flags not showing blue when they're controlled by the opposing team
[*]Fix for *settings keyboard controls not working when in world editor
[/list]
[h2]Minor Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Changed the 'you can't go home when in a vehicle' logic to work off an Extras flag rather than being determined by the vehicle type
[*]Made the big yellow arrow above buildings respect the building's 'Dont show targeting popup' flag
[*]*savemap with no name now just triggers a save of the main map
[*]Moved the sun slightly to the south
[*]Added *buildingspecialevent mode 9 to temporarily hide a building (e.g. *buildingspecialevent [building_num] 9 [hide_for_seconds] )
[*]Added the movie camera on to the main/escape menu (Esc -> M) fix for weapons UI not being hidden when movie camera turns off the UI
[*]Added close 'x' button to top right of all world ed dialogs
[*]Improved dust effects and added settings controls for various colour and dust speed options
[*]When sea level is set to 0, dont draw the sea at all. (rather than pointlessly watching it z-fighting with the ground)
[*]You can now copy & paste text into the chat window & edit boxes! COPY AND PASTE! Whatever will they think of next :).
[*]Added osd text types for gold, silver and bronze text
[*]Added an optional extra parameter to *onscreentimer to include a text message that is displayed above the timer (i.e. *onscreentimer [playername],[mode],[seconds],[text_msg] )
[*]Spec Mode Limits = 1 means a player cannot access spectator mode unless they're in a safe zone
[*]Result of *renamebuilding command is now immediately reflected client-side
[*]Added *resetallstaticflags command to, um, reset all the static flag
[*]Safe zones are now recognised on the server so that the script 'am I in safe zone?' and delete safe zones commands can work
[*]Delete Building, Rename and Edit Message buttons in world ed now working
[*]Added mouseover tooltip showing current value for world-editor sliders
[*]Increased the amount of dynamic objects / particles that can be onscreen at any one time
[*]Improved the bullet <-> wall collision positioning
[*]Fairly major rewrite of the main server download system that should allow faster downloads, better compression and (hopefully) be more reliable and less likely to affect the behaviour of the rest of the game.
[*]Graphics -> Robocrow effects = 2 adds the mode 1 trails and thrust indicators to vehicles
[*]Unified the lighting calculations for the standard landscape and ground shaders
[/list]
[h2]World updates[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Iridis[/b] : As well as making use of the new hiscore system and scripting up a fun little single-player challenge there (a proper challenge which is well worth a go if you've got any old-school gaming skills), I've added new features for controlling spectator mode and safe zones, new static flag graphics, a new energy bar display (incl. some programmer-pixel-art I'm quite pleased with :] ), improved particle effects, improved wall collisions and a bunch of stuff to improve the 'subspace' control mode that's used there.
[*][b]Lovelace[/b] : Have done a bit of rebalancing on this world, reducing a bit of the early stage grind and removing any remnants of the stuff that was pay-for (e.g. fishing is now an in-game-currency item). Still has its worth, but needs some more work to make it better balanced and improve the tail.
[*][b]Mechzone[/b] : Mechzone got a complete rebuild with new effects, new collision systems (mechs standing on buildings, you'd be amazed how much work is involved in doing that 'properly', probably worth it :] ), and a new design for a 'board-game' style mini-econ using an auction mechanic. Also needs finishing tho :)
[/list]

notes.notes:

notes.title: Update notes for May 2023
notes.notes:
Apologies for the brief delay (ok, 3 years. Fine. Be like that then).

A tractor v0.76.0 is now available. In this version:
- A new universe
- New worlds (mostly work-in-progress) ; Lovelace reset.
- Too much other stuff to list. (Ask a patron).

'Season X' has now officially started with a reset of all galactic players. If we're lucky I wont need to officially start it again before the weekend :] . Many things still need finishing, space stuff is limited but hopefully you'll have a few things to explore. Lots more to come over the next few months.

notes.title: 0.75.5 Update
notes.notes:
A new game-client is now available on steam with a few fixes and improvements:
- Fix for some of the items on the first world joined being incorrectly named and unusable
- New 'large chat text' option on the in-games options menu
- New 'World Builder' option on the frontend options to activate the world 'Create' section

I've also fixed up the interfaces to support the basic 'Bank' building - bank accounts will be added to the main world in the near future.

notes.title: Client update 0.75.4
notes.notes:
Good morning :). 
There's a new client update active now (0.75.4) - In addition to a some minor fixes and extra info to help track down the problems with post-processing, this version includes a few extra features and changes for people working on creating new worlds. Full release notes can be found [url=http://theuniversal.net/worldmanual/doku.php?id=releasenotes:2020#section0754]here[/url]. 

In other news, big congratulations to Swarthington who has managed to confound all expectations by surviving to over 100 on Lovelace.  I've also upped the Lovelace skill limit to 4 to help the tiny population currently struggling to stay alive there :]

notes.title: Development update
notes.notes:
Hi,
Just a lil note regarding progress on development of the game over the past few months.

As you may know, I'm the only person writing the game right now and I've recently started a new full-time job. Christmas was also busy this year ([i]Merry christmas and Happy New Year to you all, btw! :][/i] ), with various trips around the country to visit the family, so not much coding has been done recently. Apologies for the lack of updates, therefore.

The world still continues on and the goal of constructing the first spacecraft of the new round is still open, should anyone be dedicated enough to persevere :)

I will be building up some new bits in the next few months, primarily with regard to the next phase of the game, post-development of space travel.

Cheers
Mit

notes.title: Nutritional value and other changes
notes.notes:
A few highlights from recent code updates :

[list]
[*] (Most notably) - New nutritional value system means that if you consume (eat or drink) the same item repeatedly its nutritional value goes down (down to half its maximum value) - e.g If you drink nothing but Tea all the time, you'll only be getting 50% thirst reduction from the Tea.  [b]So basically, its better for you to have a varied diet[/b].
[*] 'Disposable RC' item replaced with a separate button
[*] Holding shift now steps up in sheckles on various controls that previously didnt support that. (e.g. set sell price)
[*] Fix for the 'Leave screen' not showing the benefit of food/drink items that are in inventory
[*] Fix for player reverting to vehicle 1 instead of default vehicle if they sell the vehicle they're in
[*] Under construction building plots can now be sold
[*] Fix for camera speed sometimes snapping up to a faster speed when rotating
[/list]

notes.title: Bugfixes..

+ various extra internal/server options to support future economy and tutorial changes.

notes.title: Major changes comin' up..
notes.notes:
Advanced notice of a few major changes to the way the game is structured that are planned for the near future..

The first will be a trial switchover to an 'active employment' system - whereby workers will no longer be attached passively to a particular building, and will instead need to actively work buildings to collect wages - More details on this will follow closer to the time, .

Within the next few weeks I'll be removing the separate purchase of the Residence Permit and bundling that in with an initial purchase price for the game. In the near term, those of you who have got the game for free will still be allowed in, and the building restrictions for free players will be relaxed slightly. Those who have already purchased a Permit will gain extra benefits. 

Thirdly, players who acquired government buildings during the startup phase will be served with 'Compulsory Purchase Orders', requiring the return of the building to government hands.

And finally, we'll be adding in some new rules regarding the manipulation of the economy through the creation of 'fake' player accounts. Please note that this is considered cheating and anyone found to be cheating in this way will risk removal from the main world and may be denied access to new worlds in the future..

notes.title: Client update 0.74.1.3
notes.notes:
Improvements and fixes in the recent Early Access client updates:

- Improved collision checks on buildings
- Extra info on building screens to indicate when a building is full
- Tenant is no longer removed from building when it is sold (Further additions to this system will be added later, including a notice-period for removing a tenant).
- A few rendering fixes (incl. reducing the over-bright crops in farm fields)
- Some fixes for auto-drive/right click.
- Fuel stations can now be built in residential areas.
- Fixes for construction of region-based buildings, such as the limestone quarry and ore mines.

Also added a couple of new decorative items to the store. (Headphones and Wizard's Hat).

notes.title: Patch notes: 0.74.0.6
notes.notes:
A couple more minor client & server updates since the last patch notes, various bugfixes and little additions:

- 'Exports' building owners can now change one of the items they trade in once every 24 hours.
- Some server fixes that may resolve some odd connection issues as reported on the discussions page
- Fixed crow spec camera height
- Fix for people sometimes getting stuck as an employee in workhouses
- Added in-game options screen (ESC then O) and defaulted to WASD controls
- Workhouse owners can now adjust the wage level they pay
- Shortened the mayoral election process by a gameyear.
- Employers can now select specific users to fire rather than just picking one at random.

notes.title: Patch notes: 0.74.0.4
notes.notes:
Minor client update (0.74.0.4) released today addresses a couple of issues:

- Fix for the 'Purchased Items' screen not working if you have a lot of items
- When you're renting a building out you can now access the 'Building Admin' section to adjust sale price etc.

I also spent a lil while adding in a funky Bonogchimp Worship Meter (so funky it has to be capitalised) but thats for another time.. :]

notes.title: A tractor first Early Access release
notes.notes:
Welcome all to the new version of A tractor. 

The initial public release went well enough, with lots more people arriving than I was expecting and absolutely *no* mad running about, getting very stressed, trying to keep the servers from frying. No. Absolutely none of that.

I've released a couple of minor client patches since then, just to fix a few graphical issues and to include a few missing downloads that were the cause of a few lag problems when things got busy last night.

For those of you who are staying around, we'll shortly be witnessing the morbidly fascinating process of the mass death of a large number of passing casuals, most likely not long before we all start wondering how we're going to survive without any Tea.

Lots more work to come, bugs to be fixed, systems to be added and with any luck the Descending Chimp will keep us all safe and secure in the shade of his Giant Bongos.
